# Feature brief template

Copy this file into `product/features/<slug>.md` and fill it in. Delete this heading line when done.

- **Status:** draft
- **Owner:**

## Problem

The player experience this addresses, in one paragraph.

## Who it serves

Roles affected, using [glossary](../product/glossary.md) terms.

## Workflow

Steps as they happen at the table today, then steps as they should happen in Clocktower.

## In scope / out of scope

Two short lists.

## Data and screens

Which records the feature creates or reads, and which screens show them. Keep it factual; detail belongs in technical/ once the brief is agreed.

## Open questions

Questions raised for the owner or the team, so nothing is decided silently.

## Decisions

Link entries from [product/decisions.md](../product/decisions.md) or [technical/decisions.md](../technical/decisions.md) when the feature forces a durable choice.

## Canvas

If the feature maps across several areas, link the canvas that shows those relationships.
